prompts.title: Swim
prompts.desktop: Use WASD or the arrow keys to swim. Left-click (or J) squirts ink at what you point at; the ink takes a moment to refill. F grabs, talks and buys.
prompts.touch: Touch and drag on the left of the screen to swim.

prompts.title: Dash
prompts.desktop: Press Space or Shift for a burst of speed. Creatures cannot touch you mid-dash.
prompts.touch: Tap the Dash button for a burst of speed. Creatures cannot touch you mid-dash.

prompts.title: Bomb the floor
prompts.desktop: This floor is in the way. Swim over it and press B to drop a bomb: it sinks straight down and sits where it lands. Or pick the bomb on the bar and right-click at the cursor: a thrown one sticks to the first rock it hits. Then swim away, the blast hurts you too.
prompts.touch: This floor is in the way. Hover over the floor and tap Bomb (your bombs are picked on the bar at the top): it drops straight down and sits where it lands. Then swim away: the blast hurts you too.

prompts.title: The exit
prompts.desktop: Swim to the whirlpool and press F (or middle-click) to finish the tutorial. It takes you back to the hub, and the kelp on the dive opens for good.
prompts.touch: Swim to the whirlpool and tap Enter to finish the tutorial. It takes you back to the hub, and the kelp on the dive opens for good.
